violation_type.title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §747.209(2))
violation_type.short_title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation did not update their liability insurance information by the renewal date.

finding_variants.text: The operation did not update their liability insurance information by the renewal date.
Liability insurance verification was due on 3/28/24 and no completed.
Operation does not have liability insurance.
The operation has not updated their liability insurance, it was due by 03/22/2024.
The operation failed to provide proof of coverage for their liability insurance.

During inspection, the primary caregiver could not provide proof of current liability insurance. The most recent insurance coverage document presented indicated that the provider's insurance expired on 08/04/2025.
